title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 4: the call to break up fallow ground, the lion from the north, and Jeremiah's anguish over the coming destruction.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell the men of Judah and Jerusalem to break up?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Break up your fallow ground, and don't sow among thorns."

questions.text: What were the men of Judah told to circumcise?
questions.explanation: They were told, "Circumcise yourselves to Yahweh, and take away the foreskins of your heart," lest his wrath go out like fire.

answers.text: Their sons on the eighth day

questions.text: From which direction did Yahweh say he would bring evil and a great destruction?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "Flee for safety! Don't wait; for I will bring evil from the north, and a great destruction."

answers.text: From the wilderness in the south

questions.text: What has gone up from his thicket to make the land desolate?
questions.explanation: The verse says, "A lion has gone up from his thicket, and a destroyer of nations. He is on his way."

answers.text: A bear robbed of her cubs
An eagle swooping on its prey
A lion, a destroyer of nations

questions.text: What did the speaker say this people and Jerusalem had been told, even though the sword reaches to the heart?
questions.explanation: The speaker said, "Surely you have greatly deceived this people and Jerusalem, saying, 'You will have peace;' whereas the sword reaches to the heart."

questions.text: The horses of the one who comes up like clouds are swifter than what?
questions.explanation: The verse says, "his chariots will be as the whirlwind. His horses are swifter than eagles."

questions.text: What is Jerusalem told to wash from wickedness so that she may be saved?
questions.explanation: The verse says, "Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved."

questions.text: When the speaker looked at the earth, what did he see?
questions.explanation: He says, "I saw the earth, and, behold, it was waste and void, and the heavens, and they had no light."

answers.text: It was full of violence and corruption
It was waste and void, and the heavens had no light
It was covered with deep waters
It was burning with unquenchable fire

questions.text: Though the whole land will be a desolation, what did Yahweh say he would not do?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said, "The whole land will be a desolation; yet I will not make a full end."

answers.text: He would not hide his face
He would not make a full end
He would not remember their sin

questions.text: Whose voice did the speaker hear, like a voice of a woman in travail?
questions.explanation: He heard "the voice of the daughter of Zion, who gasps for breath, who spreads her hands."

answers.text: The voice of the daughter of Zion
The voice of the daughter of Egypt
The voice of the queen of the sky
